description: Budget guard for top-tier expensive models (Claude Code Fable, Codex astra): keeps one session from burning the whole plan quota and stalling every other session. Below the reserve line it is a soft CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md rule (expensive model only thinks, plans and reviews; heavy work goes to cheap subagents); once 5h/7d remaining quota drops under a time-decaying reserve, a PreToolUse hook enforces the split. Triggers: install model guard, fable guard, 装模型预算闸, 贵模型保护, 更新贵模型列表, 改保留额, 卸载模型预算闸.
